method_observation.observation: Port-call recall stays high-yield when documentary permissions, service orders, money and local information are modeled as operational states with timestamps. A physically open berth and seaworthy ship can still be unavailable to trade because clearance, coordination or funding is not ready; future port research should preserve administrative readiness alongside physical capacity.

proposed_validation_probe.reason: P008 closes the port-call administrative and husbandry chain with high novelty. A remaining orthogonal information-infrastructure gap is how hydrographic offices, charts and notices, weather/ocean forecasts, routeing services and navigation-information updates shape voyage safety, routing and effective capacity. This can expose provenance and update-lag failure modes without becoming a chart-provider, software-vendor or current-regulation catalog.

stop_reason: The preset questions were answered with a coherent agency, clearance, husbandry, disbursement and digital-information topology. Marginal recall then shifted toward exact local forms and notice windows, agent authority clauses, current single-window implementations, tariffs and specific compliance cases; those require claim-scoped Evidence or would become a port/vendor directory.
